cards.name: Sourdough Starter
cards.caption: Feed me. Every. Day.
cards.flavor: 2020: stuck at home, everyone grew a bubbly sourdough starter, named it and fed it daily.
cards.art: Real photo of a homemade sourdough starter: bubbly, risen beige levain in a glass jar (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0).

cards.name: Dalgona Coffee
cards.caption: Whisk 400 times. Worth it
cards.flavor: Korea to the world, 2020: fluffy whipped coffee on milk, lockdown's first TikTok hit.
cards.art: Real photo of homemade dalgona coffee: a thick cap of whipped caramel-brown coffee foam on a glass of milk (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0).

cards.name: Polish Cow
cards.caption: *Polish music plays*
cards.flavor: July 2020: a low-poly cow dancing to a Polish banger, looped for hours. Peak 3 a.m.
cards.art: The original Polish Cow clip: the pixelated black-and-white 3D cow mid-dance on a white background (KYM gallery GIF frame).

cards.name: Stick Bug
cards.caption: Get stick bugged lol
cards.flavor: 2020's bait-and-switch: any video could suddenly cut to a swaying stick insect.
cards.art: Frame from the original 2018 stick bug clip: a pale stick insect swaying on a concrete ledge (KYM gallery GIF, no caption).

cards.name: Vibing Cat
cards.caption: Head bob intensifies
cards.flavor: 2020: Minette the white cat bobbed her head on TikTok and became the sound of vibing.
cards.art: The canonical catJAM frame: close-up of the white cat's face, eyes half closed, head tilted mid-bob (YouTube thumbnail of the clip).

cards.name: I'm Not a Cat
cards.caption: I'm here live. Not a cat
cards.flavor: Feb 2021: a Texas lawyer stuck behind a kitten filter in a Zoom court hearing.
cards.art: The Zoom kitten filter itself: the fluffy white kitten face with big sad green eyes, isolated on white (no person visible).

cards.name: Big Floppa
cards.caption: Floppa is friend
cards.flavor: 2020: Gosha the caracal and his giant ear tufts became the internet's beloved big cat.
cards.art: The original Big Floppa photo: Gosha the caracal lying on a window sill, ear tufts up, staring calmly at the camera.

cards.name: Toilet Paper Panic
cards.caption: Worth more than gold
cards.flavor: March 2020: shelves emptied and rolls hoarded. The one true currency of lockdown.
cards.art: Real photo of a completely empty toilet-roll aisle at an Australian supermarket, March 2020 (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0).

cards.name: Ever Given
cards.caption: Tiny digger, giant job
cards.flavor: March 2021: a giant ship wedged across the Suez Canal vs. one very brave tiny digger.
cards.art: The Suez Canal Authority photo: a lone excavator digging at the towering red bulbous bow of the stuck Ever Given.

cards.name: Bing Chilling
cards.caption: Now I have bing chilling
cards.flavor: 2021: John Cena greets China in Mandarin, ice cream in hand. 'Bīngqílín' lives forever.
cards.art: Still from John Cena's 2021 Weibo clip: Cena in a suit in his car, mid-sentence, holding up a vanilla ice cream cone.

cards.name: Bernie's Mittens
cards.caption: I am once again sitting
cards.flavor: Jan 2021: Bernie Sanders sat at the inauguration in cozy mittens, then sat everywhere.
cards.art: Brendan Smialowski's AFP photo: Bernie Sanders on a folding chair in a parka, face mask and patterned wool mittens at the 2021 inauguration.

cards.name: Coffin Dance
cards.caption: Going out in style
cards.flavor: Ghana's dancing pallbearers + 'Astronomia' = 2020's ending to every fail video.
cards.art: The famous Coffin Dance frame: Ghana's dancing pallbearers in suits, sunglasses and caps, carrying a coffin on their shoulders.
